name: ordinal_word
description: Convert positions 1-10 to English ordinal words, compared with extracting the position number.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
words='first second third fourth fifth sixth seventh eighth ninth tenth'.split()
items=[]; controls=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=i%10+1; noun=random.choice(['runner','student','car','cyclist','entry'])
 stem=f'The {noun} finished in position {n}. '
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'In one lowercase English ordinal word, the finishing position was','answer':' '+words[n-1]})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+'In digits, the finishing position was','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
